author: Good Enough
description:
If a lion attacks you, staying calm and reacting correctly could be the difference between life and death.

Lions are powerful apex predators capable of incredible speed, strength, and coordination when hunting. This video explains what to do during a lion attack, the mistakes that can make the situation more dangerous, and how to improve your chances of surviving the encounter.

This Short breaks down survival tips for one of the most feared predators on Earth and what experts recommend if you ever come face-to-face with a lion in the wild.
title: If a Lion Attacks You, Do This 🦁😲 #animals #wildlife #survival #facts
